validation_or_gate: Record Qwen3-0.6B locale failure, Qwen3-1.7B runtime timeout, multimodal no-winner, Step LoRA sentinel failure, and privacy rules.
stop_rule: Do not reopen completed human review or raw multimodal gates.

validation_or_gate: Verify current model IDs, licenses, parameter sizes, runtime backends, duration limits, and training feasibility from primary sources.
stop_rule: Stop a model before runtime if license, weight, or dependency policy is not usable.

validation_or_gate: Record artifact class, count, sensitivity, storage policy, hash status, and split policy only.
stop_rule: No row IDs, transcripts, audio paths, or model outputs in Git.

validation_or_gate: Run existing 15-row raw evidence through deterministic OpenCC/Taiwan-term deployment repair and automatic semantic proxy.
stop_rule: Stop if repaired view has locale residuals or semantic blockers.

validation_or_gate: Isolated cache, pinned versions, explicit timeout, one-row raw inference, locale scan.
stop_rule: No first inference row means no fixed-15 and no LoRA.

validation_or_gate: FireRedASR AED/LLM license, weights, dependency, duration, and one-row feasibility.
stop_rule: Stop any variant with non-reproducible runtime or unsuitable duration boundary.

validation_or_gate: Run fixed-15 only for models with one-row success; compute raw CER/WER and raw locale metrics.
stop_rule: Stop models that fail transcript contract or raw output validity.

validation_or_gate: Apply deterministic Simplified-to-Traditional conversion, Taiwan terms, punctuation normalization, and safe formatting only.
stop_rule: Stop if conversion changes meaning by proxy or leaves locale residuals.

validation_or_gate: Record raw baseline, Traditional Chinese deployment-repair baseline, subgroup baseline, and frozen LoRA comparison surfaces according to baseline_experiment_matrix.tsv.
stop_rule: Do not collapse raw, repaired, subgroup, and LoRA comparison evidence into one score.

validation_or_gate: Check CER/WER worsening, critical-term changes, proper nouns, abbreviations, length ratio, empty-output changes, low overlap, and locale residuals.
Classify each failure as runtime, duration, raw capability, locale, deterministic-repair, semantic-damage, subgroup, fine-tuning-addressable, or research-probe.
stop_rule: Do not open LoRA merely because CER/WER is imperfect; record either a diagnostic-triggered reason or a bounded research-probe reason with expected consequence checks.

validation_or_gate: Use accepted ground-truth train rows only; freeze validation and test; track hash/status only.
stop_rule: Stop if split leakage or transcript-bearing payload would enter Git.

validation_or_gate: Train the smallest feasible adapter, save locally, reload, and run one-row post-training evaluation.
stop_rule: No adapter reload or one-row transcript means no rank/alpha sweep.

validation_or_gate: Run ordered rank/alpha grid only for candidates whose smoke adapter passes.
stop_rule: Stop wider ranks when smaller rank fails semantic proxy or resource gate.

validation_or_gate: Evaluate frozen fixed-15 and semantic proxy against raw and repaired baselines.
stop_rule: Stop if LoRA improves locale but worsens semantic damage or overfits.

validation_or_gate: Run only for clean survivors; subgroup by Taiwan terms, code-switching, bank/health/identity/reporting terms, duration, noise.
stop_rule: No clean fixed-15/proxy survivor means skip.

validation_or_gate: Decide whether any survivor earns 30-row CDS, 258-row, or selected-300 route under scoped evidence.
stop_rule: Do not advance without claim-evidence alignment.

validation_or_gate: Record scoped survivor or no-human no-winner closeout; update docs, registry, planning.
stop_rule: Close when every feasible route has evidence or bounded deferral.
